evaluate_rotated_coco_predictions: use RotatedCOCOEvaluator to evaluate rotated bounding box detection predictions against COCO ground truth annotations
compute_rotated_iou: use RotatedCOCOeval.compute_iou_dt_gt to compute pairwise IoU between detected and ground truth rotated boxes
convert_boxlist_to_tensor: use RotatedCOCOeval.boxlist_to_tensor to convert a list or numpy array of boxes into a PyTorch tensor with optional dimension conversion
check_rotated_boxes: use RotatedCOCOeval.is_rotated to check whether a box list contains 5-dimensional rotated bounding boxes
convert_instances_to_json: use RotatedCOCOEvaluator.instances_to_json to convert detected instances with rotated boxes into COCO JSON format results
